her fingernail tracing along the edge of a tarnished silver reliquary
velvet train dragging slowly over scattered rose petals and dust
shallow exhale fogging the surface of a cracked obsidian mirror
distant pipe organ sustaining a single low note through empty corridors
lace cuff brushing against the cold brass handle of a crypt door
footstep echoing once in the vaulted stone ceiling above her
wax dripping from a candelabra onto marble with soft irregular taps
iron key scraping against the inside of an ancient lock mechanism
her swallow audible in the absolute stillness of the ossuary
frankincense smoke hissing faintly as it rises from the thurible
hem of her gown catching on a splinter of oak pew
bell tolling three times from the tower, then stopping abruptly mid-swing
her palm sliding across dusty vellum pages in the scriptorium
raven claw scratching against slate tiles on the chapel roof
bone hairpin falling and striking granite with a delicate chime
choir voices filtering through stone walls, muffled and wordless
wind moaning through the gaps in stained glass high overhead
her tongue clicking softly against teeth in the darkness
moth wings fluttering desperately inside a glass oil lamp
carved wooden choir stall groaning under sudden weight
crystal rosary beads sliding through her fingers one by one
gargoyle mouth dripping water onto cobblestones in steady rhythm
her bare sole meeting cold mosaic tile in the transept
incense censer chain clinking as it swings from her hand
single drop of melted wax sizzling against her wrist
her knuckles brushing the iron grille of a confessional screen
breath catching sharp when cold air touches her collarbone
silk ribbon unraveling from her throat and falling to stone
distant thunder rolling through the catacombs beneath her feet
fingertips drumming once against the lid of a marble sarcophagus
her shoe scraping ash across the sanctuary floor
veil hem tearing softly on a protruding nail in the doorframe
heartbeat pulsing audible in her ears within the crypt silence
brass censer lid snapping shut with a dull metallic click
her whisper dissolving into the apse before reaching anyone
dried lavender sprig crumbling between her pressed palms
floorboard beneath the pew splitting with a sudden crack
her sigh mingling with the draft from the undercroft below
tarnished copper bell chiming faintly as she brushes past it
teeth biting down on a black jet bead to test its coldness
heavy oak door slamming shut and shaking dust from the lintel
her nails clicking rhythmically on an ivory prayer book cover
cobweb breaking across her forehead with no sound at all
wine spilling from a goblet onto parchment in slow drips
her ankle bone cracking as she kneels on the abbey floor
raven feather quill scratching hurried words across vellum in darkness
chains holding the chandelier creaking as it sways overhead
her humming vibrating faintly against the reliquary glass she leans near
mildew-softened hymnal page tearing as she turns it too quickly
sole of her boot meeting a loose mosaic tile that rattles
